coordinates: right-handed Z-up: x right, y away, z up
note: PLACEHOLDER geometry: realistic estimates, not measured (measured:false throughout). Box sizes come from config/rig.json parcels. The GLBs in assets/models were baked at older sizes; viewer/model-fit.mjs scales their parts at load time to the sizes below. Blender has not been rerun.

sweeper.name: Cylindrical Sweeper
sweeper.note: Every value is an UNMEASURED PLACEHOLDER. Sweeper frame: origin on the bench top directly under the can's centre, x right, y away from the front, z up. The can lies on its side with its axis along y; its open/top end faces the boxes (-y).

can._note: diameter 66, length 115 along y. It rests on its rolled rims (radius 33.6), so the axis is 33.6 above the bench. baseCentreMm is the centre of the back (closed) end; axisZup points from the back end to the front end, towards the boxes.

assemblyTilt._note: x axis through the can's bottom-back edge. Positive tilt lowers the stick tip (and the can's front end).

servo._note: On top of the lying can near its front end, shaft straight up. Case 23 wide (x) x 12 deep (y) x 23 tall along the shaft (caseDimensionsLocalMm is servo-local x, y, shaft); its centre is 9 mm behind the can's front end, it sits on the can's top line (z 66.6) and the shaft centre is 2 mm above the case. Servo 0 = stick to the right (+x), 90 = forward (-y), 180 = left (-x): direction -1 turns clockwise seen from above.

stick._note: Lengthened from 120 to 140 mm so the sweep carries the top box's contact point about 10 mm past both bench edges (135 mm is the bare minimum, about 4 mm). Lies flat: 10 mm wide horizontally, 3 mm thick vertically. Hung on the horn 5 mm from one end.

workbench.note: The box stack sits at the centre of rig.json zones.pick. The sweeper sits behind it on the same x, its can's front end sweeperGapToStackMm behind the stack's back face. Visual placement only: no collision or stability simulation.
